content.text: Open TV Search Sign In Roberto Sanchez Actor Roberto "Sanz" Sanchez started his entertainment career when he was just nine years old. "Sanz" Sanchez started off his acting career mostly in film roles, appearing in "Operacion Rosa Rosa" (1974), the Tomas Milian drama "Washington Heights" (2003) and the Paul Walker blockbuster action movie "2 Fast 2 Furious" (2003). He continued to act in productions like the comedy "Strange Wilderness" (2008) with Steve Zahn and "Unemployed" (2008). Several more television roles followed in the early 2000s, including stints on "Heroes" (NBC, 2006-2010) and "NCIS: Los Angeles" (CBS, 2009-). Recently, he continued to act in the Vida Guerra romantic comedy "Tamales and Gumbo" (2009), "Littlerock" (2011) and "Venom" (2013) with Jessica Morris. He also appeared in the Vida Guerra thriller "Mercy For Angels" (2015). Most recently, "Sanz" Sanchez acted on "Rosewood" (Fox, 2015-17).
